column1: # Which build-step kind each learned-mdl-preflight.md STOP-table row applies to (experiment:
# bin/lib/task-rules.sh, which inlines only the rows for the step's kind into a context pack.
# Format: TAB-separated. 1 row id as printed in the table's first cell (without the 🔎 marker)
#                        2 kind: page | logic | domain | any | retired
#   any      shown for every kind (security, script ownership, idempotency — every script)
#   retired  the row says "retired YYYY-MM-DD"; omitted from packs, kept in the file
# A row missing here is shown for every kind (fail open), so a new STOP row is never lost.
